facts.fact: Bethlem 太太在 Norwich 城外认出 Mr Beck，他曾与 Gowing 同住
facts.anchor: You lived with Mr Gowing, did you not?

facts.fact: Beck 是灵媒，他承认在 Gowing 身边学到很多
facts.anchor: And there was much that I learned by his side.

facts.fact: Beck 说自己的心智已不正常，持续一天一夜
facts.anchor: I have not been in my perfect mind. Not for a day and a night now.

facts.fact: Beck 说他脑中有一个不属于他的意识
facts.anchor: there has been in my mind an intelligence that is not my own

facts.fact: Beck 说自己正竭力阻止灾祸
facts.anchor: I am doing what I can to thwart disaster!

facts.fact: 车夫 Christian 提出把 Beck 赶走，被 Bethlem 太太无视
facts.anchor: Shall I remove him for you, ma’am? The fellow’s raving.

facts.fact: Bethlem 太太在 Beck 开口之前就知道他要说的话
facts.anchor: she knew precisely what the man was about to say before he said it

facts.fact: Beck 要去 Staringham 的 Brightwell Road，并认为那边正发生可怕的事
facts.anchor: The house on Brightwell Road. I think that, even as we stand here talking, something dreadful is happening there.

facts.fact: Bethlem 太太当场决定折返
facts.anchor: In an instant, her mind was made up and she yielded

facts.fact: 章末二人同车折返海边，商议计划并祈祷
facts.anchor: Secrets were aired and suspicions shared. Plans were made and stratagems devised. Prayers were said.
